newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy products end higher on exports, soy rally.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy products end higher on exports, soy rally.

text.p: CBOT soy product futures closed higher on a rally in soybeans, traders said.
Active exports as evidenced by strong numbers for the soy complex in USDA's weekly export sales report led the advances, the traders said.
Signals that the markets were oversold also contributed support.
Cargill Inc bought 150 lots of March soymeal and sold 700 lots of January soyoil, traders said.
Soymeal futures volume was estimated at 21,500 contracts, down from 24,788 Wednesday, according to the CBOT.
Soyoil futures volume was estimated at 15,000 contracts, down from 16,088 Wednesday.
Soymeal closed $2.90 per ton higher to $1.70 lower, with December up $2.90 at $227.80. Soyoil was 0.10 cent per lb higher to 0.06 lower, with December up 0.06 at 23.09.
